whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Cafe 13,

I noticed your café has phenomenal 4.2★ reviews with over 4,300 happy customers in Boring Road, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking & table reservation page.

Maine aapke café ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table reservation, digital menu, aur location guide integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/cafe13

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Cafe 13 team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke café ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with a digital menu, direct WhatsApp table reservation, and mobile-first speed for Boring Road food lovers. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki actual menu items aur photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain."
